notes: Hard tier only, 50 candidates. Applies the precise nameable-place method to the hard tier: every coordinate is a NAMED settlement, roadhouse, pass or junction on a long-distance route, because named places are where the Google car actually stopped. The view is still sparse — that is what sets the tier. No 'road near X' or 'edge of town' coordinates. No panoId appears here: one may only come from a real verification run.

candidates.label: Camooweal, Barkly Highway
candidates.source: Barkly Highway through the township of Camooweal, western Queensland.
candidates.rationale: Hard: a single-street outback township on a 260 km empty stretch. Red soil and spinifex give the continent, nothing gives the state.

candidates.label: Hutchison Street, Coober Pedy
candidates.source: Hutchison Street, the main street of Coober Pedy, South Australia.
candidates.rationale: Hard: mine tailings and bare rock with almost no vegetation. Distinctive to anyone who knows it, unreadable to anyone who does not — no signage identifies the desert.

candidates.label: Brolga Street, Quilpie
candidates.rationale: Hard: a wide empty outback main street with a handful of low buildings. 700 km from the Winton entry.

candidates.label: Lindis Pass summit, SH8
candidates.source: State Highway 8 at the Lindis Pass summit, Otago.
candidates.rationale: Hard: bare tussock hills, no trees, no buildings, no signage beyond a route marker. Plausibly Patagonia or central Asia to a player without local knowledge.

candidates.label: Arthur's Pass village, SH73
candidates.source: SH73 through Arthur's Pass village, Canterbury.
candidates.rationale: Hard: a dozen buildings under beech forest and scree slopes. Alpine and southern-hemisphere, but the vegetation is the only real clue.

candidates.label: Wairau Valley village, SH63
candidates.source: SH63 through Wairau Valley village, Marlborough.
candidates.rationale: Hard: dry valley farmland with a two-building settlement. Could be inland Australia or Chile on the vegetation alone.

candidates.label: Turtagrø, Sognefjellsvegen
candidates.rationale: Hard: bare rock and snow patches above the treeline with a single lodge. No Norwegian marker in frame beyond the road surface.

candidates.label: Dyranut, Rv7 Hardangervidda
candidates.source: Rv7 across the Hardangervidda plateau at Dyranut.
candidates.rationale: Hard: treeless high plateau, snow poles along the verge. The snow poles are the clue — they narrow it to northern Europe and no further.

candidates.label: Ifjord, Fv98
candidates.source: Fv98 at the Ifjord settlement, Finnmark.
candidates.rationale: Hard: arctic tundra and a handful of buildings. 380 km from the E6 Finnmark entry, and just as sparse.

candidates.label: Villa Cerro Castillo, Carretera Austral
candidates.source: Ruta 7 through Villa Cerro Castillo, Aysén.
candidates.rationale: Hard: a gravel-shouldered street of tin-roofed houses under Patagonian peaks. Spanish signage is minimal and the architecture is generic.

candidates.label: Baquedano, Ruta 5
candidates.source: Ruta 5 at the Baquedano junction, Antofagasta region.
candidates.rationale: Hard: absolute desert with a rail crossing and a few sheds. Indistinguishable from the Sahara or Namibia without reading the signs.

candidates.label: Belén, Ruta Nacional 40
candidates.rationale: Hard: an arid Andean-foothill town with adobe frontage. 1500 km from the RN40 Patagonia entry and visually unrelated to it.

candidates.label: Piedra del Águila, Ruta 237
candidates.source: RN237 at Piedra del Águila, Neuquén.
candidates.rationale: Hard: Patagonian steppe, wind-bent scrub, one fuel station. The steppe reads as Patagonia or central Asia and nothing narrows it.

candidates.label: Catriel, Ruta 151
candidates.rationale: Hard: oilfield country — pump jacks, dust, low scrub. Could be Texas or Kazakhstan on the landscape alone.

candidates.label: Victoria West, N12
candidates.source: N12 through Victoria West, Northern Cape.
candidates.rationale: Hard: Karoo scrub and corrugated-iron roofs. 300 km from the Karoo Highway entry, and equally featureless.

candidates.label: Barrydale, R62
candidates.rationale: Hard: fynbos and dry mountains behind a one-street village. Afrikaans signage is the only firm clue and it is sparse.

candidates.label: Kakamas, N14
candidates.rationale: Hard: irrigated vines against bare desert hills — a contradiction that misleads as often as it helps. 400 km from the N7 Namaqualand entry.

candidates.label: Vanderhoof, Highway 16
candidates.rationale: Hard: boreal forest and a low commercial strip. Interchangeable with rural Finland, Russia or Alaska without reading a sign.

candidates.label: Wawa, Highway 17
candidates.rationale: Hard: Canadian Shield rock cuts and spruce. 1900 km from the Swift Current entry and just as anonymous.

candidates.label: Fort Macleod, Highway 2
candidates.rationale: Hard: dry prairie with grain infrastructure. Reads as the northern Great Plains without distinguishing country.

candidates.label: Matehuala, Mex 57
candidates.source: Mex 57 through Matehuala, San Luis Potosí.
candidates.rationale: Hard: high-desert scrub and a utilitarian highway strip. Spanish signage places the region, not the country — it could be Chile or Argentina.

candidates.label: Jiménez, Mex 45
candidates.rationale: Hard: Chihuahuan desert flats. 900 km from the Mex 1 Cataviña entry and similarly empty.

candidates.label: Tecpan de Galeana, Mex 200
candidates.source: Mex 200 through Tecpan de Galeana, Guerrero.
candidates.rationale: Hard: tropical Pacific coast lowland with palm thatch and concrete block. Reads as anywhere between Nayarit and Nicaragua.

candidates.label: Ayaviri, PE-3S
candidates.rationale: Hard: 3900 m altiplano, adobe and tin, no trees. 130 km from the Juliaca altiplano entry, which is the nearest thing in the catalog and still a separate cluster.

candidates.label: Huarmey, Panamericana Norte
candidates.rationale: Hard: coastal desert with grey overcast and unfinished brick. 300 km from the Nazca entry.

candidates.label: Huamachuco, PE-3N
candidates.rationale: Hard: northern highland town, steep treeless slopes, minimal signage. Nothing separates it from Bolivia or Ecuador visually.

candidates.label: Kochkor, A367
candidates.rationale: Hard: Soviet-era concrete and poplar rows under bare mountains. Cyrillic signage points to a wide swathe of Central Asia.

candidates.label: Toktogul, Bishkek–Osh highway
candidates.rationale: Hard: reservoir basin ringed by dry mountains. 200 km from the Naryn pass entry.

candidates.label: Alausí, E35
candidates.rationale: Hard: steep Andean valley town, corrugated roofs, thin signage. 120 km from the Baños entry.

candidates.label: Macas, E45
candidates.source: E45 Troncal Amazónica at Macas, Morona Santiago.
candidates.rationale: Hard: Amazon-slope town, dense green, low concrete. Could be Peru, Colombia or Bolivia on the vegetation alone.

candidates.label: Sacapulas, RN-7W
candidates.rationale: Hard: dry river canyon with scattered buildings. 60 km from the Chichicastenango entry and far barer.

candidates.label: Río Hondo, CA-9
candidates.rationale: Hard: dry tropical valley and a highway service strip. No highland markers, so the usual Guatemala cues are absent.

candidates.label: Mogadouro, N221
candidates.rationale: Hard: stone and render on a bare interior plateau. Routinely mistaken for inland Spain, which is 30 km away.

candidates.label: Odemira, N120
candidates.rationale: Hard: low whitewashed buildings and cork oak. 90 km from the N2 Alentejo entry, same tier of emptiness.

candidates.label: Alcañiz, N-420
candidates.rationale: Hard: arid Aragonese uplands, ochre stone, almost no vegetation. Reads as anywhere in the Mediterranean interior.

candidates.label: Almazán, N-122
candidates.rationale: Hard: high meseta, cereal fields, a walled town seen edge-on. 400 km from the Ronda countryside entry.

candidates.label: Kamishihoro, Route 273
candidates.rationale: Hard: wide fields and larch shelterbelts. Hokkaido routinely reads as Canada or northern Europe until the signage is found.

candidates.label: Ōshika village, Route 152
candidates.rationale: Hard: a single-lane mountain road through cedar forest with a handful of houses. Steep, dark and almost signless.

candidates.label: Chiang Kham, Route 1148
candidates.rationale: Hard: northern hill farmland with sparse roadside building. 120 km from the 1095 Pai entry.

candidates.label: Nakhon Thai, Route 12
candidates.rationale: Hard: lowland rice country against forested hills, minimal Thai signage in frame. Could be Laos or Cambodia.

candidates.label: Niğde, D750
candidates.rationale: Hard: dry Anatolian plateau, concrete apartment blocks, volcanic hills. 700 km from the Istanbul entry and nothing like it.

candidates.label: Sungurlu, D100
candidates.rationale: Hard: rolling cereal steppe with a highway service strip. Latin-script Turkish is the one clue, and it is easy to miss.

candidates.label: Eureka, US 50
candidates.rationale: Hard: Great Basin sagebrush and a two-block main street. The catalog's four US entries are all major-city views; this is the opposite.

candidates.label: Jeffrey City, US 287
candidates.rationale: Hard: a near-abandoned settlement on high plains. Almost no signage and no vegetation above knee height.

candidates.label: Malta, US 2
candidates.rationale: Hard: northern prairie, grain elevators, wide sky. Indistinguishable from Saskatchewan 130 km north.

candidates.label: Karongi, RN6
candidates.rationale: Hard: terraced hills above Lake Kivu with little built form. 100 km from both Rwandan entries.

candidates.label: Nuwara Eliya, A5
candidates.source: A5 at Nuwara Eliya, Central Province.
candidates.rationale: Hard: tea slopes at 1900 m with eucalypts and mist — cool, green and entirely unlike the tropical default. 70 km from Ella.

candidates.label: Aguachica, Ruta 45
candidates.rationale: Hard: hot lowland highway strip, motorcycle traffic, low concrete. None of the Andean cues the catalog's other Colombian entries carry.

candidates.label: Barreiras, BR-020
candidates.rationale: Hard: cerrado agribusiness country — flat, dusty, red soil. 800 km from the Minas rural entry.

candidates.label: Melo, Ruta 8
candidates.rationale: Hard: rolling cattle country near the Brazilian border, sparse building. 300 km from the Ruta 9 Rocha entry.
